visual.name: bfusionScheduleRiskForecast
visual.description: Monte Carlo schedule-risk simulation: P10/P50/P90 finish-date S-curve, confidence-to-target KPI, and top schedule-risk drivers — derived from task durations and the dependency network, no 3-point estimates required.

dataRoles.name: taskId
dataRoles.description: Unique task identifier — bind together with Predecessor ID to simulate the dependency network.

dataRoles.name: predecessorId
dataRoles.description: ID(s) of the task this task depends on (Tasks waiting on its finish). One row per dependency; leave unbound to use planned Start Date scheduling.

dataRoles.name: startDate
dataRoles.description: Planned task start. Anchors finish dates when no dependency network is supplied.

dataRoles.name: percentComplete
dataRoles.description: 0-1 or 0-100. Only the remaining fraction of each task's duration is simulated.

dataRoles.name: targetDate
dataRoles.description: Optional milestone/deadline used for the confidence-to-target KPI.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

mode.description: Surface theme for the visual chrome. Auto follows the report theme's background.

background.description: Custom mode only. Plot and root background.

surface.description: Custom mode only. Header, toolbar, panels, tiles and tooltips.

textColor.description: Custom mode only. Primary text colour.

mutedColor.description: Custom mode only. Labels, captions and axis text.

ruleColor.description: Custom mode only. Separators, tile borders and axis lines.

iterations.description: Monte Carlo trials (250-5000). Higher = smoother curve, slower.

optimisticPct.description: Best-case duration as % below the planned value (e.g. 10 = -10%).

pessimisticPct.description: Worst-case duration as % above the planned value (e.g. 35 = +35%).

manualTargetDays.displayName: Manual Target (days from start, 0 = use field)

reserveConfidence.description: Percentile used for the schedule-reserve recommendation (e.g. 80).

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
